title: Who can apply (ukri.org)
text:
This is not a research grant opportunity.
This funding opportunity consists of two elements:
England-only pilots (around £4 million) and
cross-UK innovation partnerships seed funding (£15 million).
The latter (UK-wide) of which has different eligibility to the former (England only).
Throughout this funding opportunity, you should assume all text is relevant to the entire funding opportunity (including England-only pilots and cross-UK innovation partnerships seed funding), with any specific cross-UK innovation partnerships conditions as additional, unless expressly stated otherwise.
This funding opportunity is open to organisations with standard eligibility Check if your organisation is eligible and who meet the eligibility of this opportunity detailed below.
Research England will discount any application which does not meet the eligibility criteria. If you are unsure, please contact the UKRI Funding Service Helpdesk.
Who is eligible to apply
There is different eligibility for the two elements of this funding opportunity: England-only pilots (£4 million total) and cross-UK innovation partnerships seed funding (£15 million total)
For England-only pilots we welcome applications from English higher education providers where the English higher education provider must be registered with the Office for Students (OfS) in the approved (fee cap) category of the OfS’s register. This includes continuing to meet the OfS’s ongoing conditions of registration.
For the cross-UK innovation partnerships seed funding, we welcome applications from higher education providers in England as outlined in the previous paragraph. We also welcome applications from higher education providers in Wales, universities in Scotland and higher education institutes in Northern Ireland who meet UK Research and Innovation (UKRI)’s standard eligibility criteria. Throughout this funding opportunity that group will be referred to as ‘higher education providers.’ Cross-UK innovation partnerships may be between any areas of the UK – there is no requirement to include a higher education provider from a specific UK nation.
Demand management
An individual higher education provider may be listed as a recipient of funding from this funding opportunity in: (i) up to two applications for England-only pilots (lead provider in only one), or (ii) up to one application for the cross-UK innovation partnerships seed funding applications, or both.
If a higher education provider is to receive funding from more than two applications England-only pilots or one application for UK-wide cross-UK innovation partnerships seed funding, or both, we will endeavour to reach out to resolve with the application teams which of the applications should go forward to assessment. However, we reserve the right to cancel all applications which involve a higher education provider listed as a funding recipient in more applications than detailed here, and to do so without discussion.
Higher education providers may be involved as project partners and therefore not receiving funding, in as many applications as they deem appropriate.
Who is not eligible to apply
The following are not eligible to apply:
collaborative research projects
applications not led by higher education providers as defined under eligibility
applications which do not involve at least two higher education provider
Please see what we will and will not fund within the ‘What we are looking for’ section for this opportunity.
Equality, diversity and inclusion
We are committed to achieving equality of opportunity for all funding applicants.
Research England funds institution-led not applicant-led opportunities, including on behalf of UKRI for UK-wide funding. As such, we expect institutions in receipt of funding to support people to work in a way that suits their personal circumstances. This includes:
career breaks
support for people with caring responsibilities
flexible working
alternative working patterns
UKRI can offer disability and accessibility support for UKRI applicants and grant holders during the application and assessment process.
